dialogues.speaker: Ossie
dialogues.text: You could call my "amnesia" a blessing in disguise, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Ossie
dialogues.text: Hear me now, having a bad memory isn't always a bad thing. The less you remember, the less obsessive you become.

dialogues.speaker: Ossie
dialogues.text: Take that "Granny Itztli" Citlali, for instance. It's been how many years, and she still can't let that unfinished serial novel of hers go!

dialogues.speaker: Ossie
dialogues.text: *sigh* What was it called again... Heh, I've forgotten...
